My background combines content creation with a technical, research-driven approach. As a freelance SEO and content specialist, I write blog and web content that has to earn attention, and I use analytics and AI tools daily to find what resonates. Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Bored Panda team,

I'm applying for the remote Scriptwriter position at Bored Panda Studios. What draws me to this role is the way your teams combine creativity with data and AI, experiment quickly and scale what works. That's how I like to work too.

My path has been a mix of content and technology. As a freelance SEO and content specialist, I write blog and web content designed to attract and keep readers, and I research keywords and trends to decide what's worth writing about. I use LLMs such as Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content and audits, and I've built and optimized websites from scratch, including structured data and AI-search visibility. That work has taught me how small choices in structure, pacing and format affect whether an audience stays engaged.

I also have hands-on web and front-end experience, including AngularJS and JavaScript development for a healthcare application. That technical grounding helps me write scripts with production in mind: I understand what is feasible to film and how ideas move from concept to screen. I'm fluent in English, self-motivated, and comfortable meeting deadlines while adapting to feedback.

I haven't yet written scripts specifically for YouTube, but I've spent years creating content for the web and studying what makes people click, watch and share. I'd bring a research-first, audience-focused approach to your video team, and I'd be glad to complete a test task to show how I think.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to Bored Panda Studios' next big hit.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
